purpose: Prove that MUSIAM can mine owner/official/archive sources by stable work identity while separating direct owner statements, official release data, approved artifacts, AI-derived interpretation, and knowledge gaps.

sourceClasses.OWNER_MESSAGE: Direct statement by 伯爵 / ABI伯爵, including signed published Letters.
sourceClasses.OWNER_PUBLISHED_MEDIA: Published/saved owner-authored media with clear owner attribution.
sourceClasses.OFFICIAL_RELEASE_DATA: Owned release metadata or lyrics exported from distribution/catalog records.
sourceClasses.APPROVED_ARTIFACT: A MUSIAM artifact that was actually produced/approved/published; may still contain AI-assisted prose and is not automatically an autobiographical statement.
sourceClasses.AI_DERIVED_FROM_OFFICIAL_SOURCE: AI analysis based on official lyrics/assets. Useful interpretation, never owner intent.
sourceClasses.AI_DRAFT: Unapproved assistant/model suggestion or generic generated brief. Never promoted to owner intent.
sourceClasses.OPERATIONAL_LOG: Automation/deployment/catalog log. Identity/status evidence only, not creative meaning.
sourceClasses.KNOWLEDGE_GAP: No sufficiently strong source found for the requested semantic claim.

sourceRoots.note: 343-session Codex export; useful but dominated by operational history and approval wrappers.
Filtered MUSIAM Codex history. Good for locating prior work, not automatically an owner-primary source.
Project memory snapshots/manifests/history. Strong for locating project artifacts and old repository facts.

works.title: Fuego en la Noche

supports: The owner publicly described the work as a passionate contrast to the previous quiet/mythic piece.
The owner explicitly described deliberate contrast/range as part of the館 identity.
The owner explicitly connected the work with night's dual nature: sleeping and burning/aliveness.
doesNotSupport: Any private biographical event not stated in the Letter.
A claim that every detailed lyrical image is autobiographical.

supports: Official release date and identifiers.

sources.publicHandling: Do not duplicate full lyrics into public knowledge records by default; store derived semantics and source locator.

supports: An archived product-artifact extract describes the song as Spanish/English passionate Latin pop and includes an MV visual concept.

works.title: Görli Garden

The text directly depicts a Berlin park, freedom, community, non-judgment and multicultural coexistence.
The repeated chorus includes Görli Garden as a feeling rather than merely a place.
sources.publicHandling: Use semantic summaries; do not reproduce full lyrics by default.

supports: Prior MV planning read lyrics.txt and characterized the work around freedom, community, peace, greenery and gentle anti-authoritarianism.
Prior planning treated a repeated chorus as the core visual segment.
sources.caution: This is assistant analysis of source material, not direct owner intent.

allowedKnowledgeNow: Lyrics strongly support themes of park life, community, freedom, non-judgment and multicultural coexistence.
It can be discussed confidently at the level of lyrical content.
prohibitedClaims: That 伯爵 explicitly said these themes were his personal reason for creating the song, unless a direct source is found.
works.nextMining: Locate original creation conversation or owner comment about why Görli/Görlitzer Park was chosen.
